item.coloph: ces pa'i ma rgyud gsas mkhar sde lnga'i thugs sgrub man ngag gnad 'dus kyi rgyud bskangs (skong)nyung 'dus 'di ni spa ston tshul khrims dbang rgyal nas bskul bzhin bstan 'brug pas dge/

ces 'di ni dbra khyung pa g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag gis gzhung nas chad pa'i dus/ lam dgon g.yung drung gtam brag tu yar tshes la sbyar ba'o/ me rta zla tshes la wa rdzong du zhal bshus pa'o//

de ltar 'jigs byed gshin rje'i cha rkyen 'di skor lung zin mched grogs kyi thu bo sgrub rgyud zhig dgu'i ya gyal skam rigs kyi bla ma a yu mang+ga dang*/ skyes bu du mas bskul ba yid la bcags te nye bar rig mchog sa mos bskul ba la brten te rig 'dzin kun grol rtsal gyis bris pa dge//
